title: Rational Silence and False Polarization: How Viewpoint Organizations and Recommender Systems Distort the Expression of Public Opinion

bias_targets.methodology: Using a nested game-theoretic model to simulate user decisions on rhetorical intensity, combined with Markov Decision Processes for viewpoint organization signaling and multi-armed bandit algorithms representing recommender systems, to evaluate how these interactions create false polarization and distort the perceived distribution of public opinion.
